people.name: Zakharia Sherel
people.subtitle: Naum’s father
people.notes: Iosif’s grandfather. The family preserved his photograph.

people.name: Naum Sherel
people.subtitle: Zakharia’s son
people.notes: Father of Iosif Naumovich Sherel.

people.name: Iosif Naumovich Sherel
people.subtitle: 1895 · Son of Naum
people.notes: Husband of Olya and father of Grisha, Fima and Klava. According to family memories, he was chairman of a collective farm. Received the Medal for the Defence of Stalingrad and was recommended for the Medal for Combat Merit in July 1945.

people.name: Olya Sherel
people.subtitle: Olya
people.notes: Wife of Iosif and mother of Grisha, Fima and Klava.

people.name: Fima Sherel
people.subtitle: Brother of Grisha and Klava
people.notes: Son of Iosif and Olya. Fima has two children who live in the United States.

people.name: Klava Giter, née Sherel
people.subtitle: Wife of Hozkel
people.notes: Daughter of Iosif and Olya, sister of Grisha and Fima. Married Hozkel Giter; their son is Sasha.

people.name: Hozkel Giter
people.subtitle: Hozkel Giter
people.notes: Husband of Klava and father of Sasha. According to family tradition, his surname was changed from Gitler to Giter.

people.name: Grigory (Grisha) Iosifovich Sherel
people.subtitle: 1924–1974 · Orinin
people.notes: Son of Iosif and Olya. Married Dasha Berman on 28 December 1949. Father of Igor and Nelia. Died in Orinin, Ukraine, in 1974. Served from August 1942 and received the Medal for Courage and the Medal for the Defence of the Caucasus.

people.name: Fima’s two children
people.subtitle: Live in the United States
people.notes: The two children of Fima Sherel, Grisha’s brother.

people.name: Sasha Giter
people.subtitle: Sasha · Son of Klava and Hozkel
people.notes: Son of Klava and Hozkel Giter. Later moved to the United States. A childhood photograph of him with his cousin Igor Sherel has been preserved.

people.name: Avrum (Abraham) Furman
people.subtitle: Head of the Furman family
people.notes: His children included Eva, Roza and Shmeyra.

people.name: Eva Berman, née Furman
people.subtitle: Eva Abramovna Furman
people.notes: Daughter of Avrum, sister of Roza and Shmeyra, and wife of Israel (Izia) Berman. Mother of Dasha, Grisha and Galochka.

people.name: Israel (Izia) Berman
people.subtitle: 1895 · Missing since June 1941
people.notes: Husband of Eva and father of Dasha, Grisha and Galochka. The family continued searching for information about his fate after the war.

people.name: Dasha Sherel, née Berman
people.notes: Daughter of Eva and Israel Berman. Married Grisha Sherel on 28 December 1949. Mother of Igor and Nelia. Immigrated to Israel in 1991 with Nelia, Fima and Gena.

people.name: Grisha Berman
people.subtitle: 1928 · Dasha’s brother
people.notes: Son of Eva and Israel Berman. Survived the evacuation with his mother and Dasha. Grisha Berman is Dasha’s brother; Grisha Sherel is her husband.

people.name: Galochka Berman
people.subtitle: Youngest daughter of Eva and Izia
people.notes: Died on a barge during evacuation eastward from the Stalingrad area.

people.name: Roza Dik, née Furman
people.subtitle: Sister of Eva and Shmeyra
people.notes: Daughter of Avrum and wife of Senya Dik. Mother of Bella, Yasha and Bronya. Worked as a nurse in Aktyubinsk and found Eva and her children.

people.name: Senya Dik
people.subtitle: Senya Dik
people.notes: Husband of Roza and father of Bella, Yasha and Bronya.

people.name: Bella Dik
people.subtitle: Daughter of Roza and Senya
people.notes: Sister of Yasha and Bronya.

people.name: Yasha Dik
people.subtitle: Son of Roza and Senya
people.notes: Brother of Bella and Bronya.

people.name: Bronya Dik
people.subtitle: Daughter of Roza and Senya
people.notes: Sister of Bella and Yasha.

people.name: Shmeyra Furman
people.subtitle: Brother of Eva and Roza
people.notes: Son of Avrum and husband of Khona. According to family testimony, he was murdered with his family during the German occupation.

people.name: Khona Furman
people.subtitle: Khona
people.notes: Wife of Shmeyra. According to family testimony, she was murdered with her family during the occupation.

people.name: Dasha Furman
people.subtitle: One of Shmeyra and Khona’s children
people.notes: Mentioned in family testimony among Shmeyra and Khona’s children. The names Dasha and Grisha recurred in the family.

people.name: Grisha Furman
people.subtitle: One of Shmeyra and Khona’s children
people.notes: Mentioned in family testimony among Shmeyra and Khona’s children. The names Dasha and Grisha recurred in the family.

people.name: Igor Sherel
people.subtitle: Elder son · Died in 1990
people.notes: Elder son of Grisha and Dasha and brother of Nelia. Lived in Kamianets-Podilskyi with his mother Dasha. Died in 1990.

people.name: Nelia Kleiner, née Sherel
people.subtitle: 1957 · Daughter of Grisha and Dasha
people.notes: Igor’s younger sister and Fima Kleiner’s wife. Lived in Chernivtsi. Immigrated to Israel in 1991 with Dasha, Fima and their son Gena.

people.name: Fima Kleiner
people.subtitle: Son of Shika and Ania
people.notes: Husband of Nelia and father of Gena. Son of Shika Kleiner and Ania Beznos, from the Kleiner family whose origins were in Sokyriany.

people.name: Shika Kleiner
people.subtitle: Father of Fima Kleiner
people.notes: Husband of Ania Beznos and father of Fima Kleiner. His story appears on the Kleiner family website.

people.name: Ania Kleiner, née Beznos
people.subtitle: Mother of Fima Kleiner
people.notes: Wife of Shika Kleiner and mother of Fima Kleiner.

people.name: Gena Kleiner
people.subtitle: Gena · Son of Nelia and Fima
people.notes: Immigrated to Israel in 1991 with his parents Nelia and Fima and his grandmother Dasha.
